deadline.value: December 1 deadline for Ph.D. in Biomedical Science program
deadline.quote: The deadline for submission of the application, the application fee, and the receipt of all supporting materials for the Ph.D. in Biomedical Science program is December 1.

gre_general.value: Submission of GRE scores is not required for full review of applications.
gre_general.quote: Submission of GRE (or MCAT, LSAT, DMAT or GMAT) scores is NOT required for full review of applications

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Biomedical Science subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Pre-application supervisor agreement is not required for PhD application review.
supervisor.quote: Submission of GRE (or MCAT, LSAT, DMAT or GMAT) scores is NOT required for full review of applications

funding.value: Admitted Ph.D. students receive graduate assistantship stipends and tuition waivers.
funding.quote: The deadline for submission of the application, the application fee, and the receipt of all supporting materials for the Ph.D. in Biomedical Science program is December 1.
